goal: Refine the Arduino skill family so it is toolchain-neutral, hardware-aware, lifecycle-oriented, composable across embedded disciplines, and aligned with current Agent Skills authoring practice.

primary_metric.name: review_requirements_covered
primary_metric.threshold: 8/8 review themes pass the repository contract validator

correctness_gates: all active SKILL.md files remain under 500 lines
root documentation links resolve to repository files
global companion skills exist at ~/.agents/skills/cli-creator and ~/.agents/skills/plugin-creator
hard_constraints: preserve existing skill directory names and examples
do not claim compilation proves hardware or system success
do not include secrets, tokens, or machine-local credentials in repository artifacts
do not overwrite the existing global skill-creator surface
keep the router concise and move detail into references

commands: for f in skills/*/SKILL.md; do wc -l "$f"; done | sort -nr
results: 20 repository skills and 5 global Arduino sibling skills were inventoried
raw ordered constexpr int and C/C++ embedded-first conventions were recorded

per_iteration_budget: one cohesive repository patch followed by deterministic validation
evaluation_method: python3 scripts/validate_arduino_skill_contract.py plus python3 scripts/validate_agent_skills.py and targeted link/line-count checks
acceptance_rule: Keep a candidate only when both validators pass, the 8/8 review themes are covered, no hard constraint is violated, and the diff remains scoped.
rollback_method: Restore only the current experiment surface with apply_patch or an explicit reverse patch after inspecting git diff; preserve unrelated user changes and rerun both validators.
plateau_rule: Stop after two consecutive candidates add no new passing review theme or require broadening beyond the editable surface.
stop_conditions: validator cannot express an objective requirement without judging prose aesthetics
a patch would remove existing operational guidance without a referenced replacement
global installation would overwrite a distinct user-owned skill
hardware or live-device evidence is required but unavailable

experiment_history.result: new contract validator correctly reported 0/8 themes before implementation
router and references reached 8/8, but a generic code-fence patch misplaced a contract block and pushed one skill to 502 lines
8/8 contract themes, 28 skills, 0 structural warnings/errors, all skills at or below 500 lines, 10/10 forward-contract cases

open_uncertainties: fresh-context semantic review must be reconciled after the latest repair slice
the local forward harness is deterministic contract evidence, not a model invocation
vendor-specific board behavior cannot be verified without target hardware and tool versions
the installer reports PromptScript incompatibility even though Codex copies completed
no physical hardware evidence is available for this software-and-docs run
